finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Genuinely, I believe the Desolate Child of Loss can be guided toward a proper Path. You’ve seen it today. He has improved his control tremendously in a small amount of time and given enough training and patience, he should one day be able to fully control it. If not in C-grade, his B-grade evolution may even turn the Desolate Child of Loss into something entirely different... perhaps even allowing it to lose its status as a False God.”
